step1_analysis.description: A passive resistor-capacitor network acting as a loop filter for a Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) or Spread-Spectrum Clock Generator (SSCG). It integrates the charge pump current to generate the VCO control voltage, providing a pole at the origin, a stabilizing zero, and a high-frequency pole to suppress ripple.

paper_reference.title: A Spread-Spectrum Clock Generator With Triangular Modulation

transimpedance_1kHz.description: Magnitude of the transimpedance at 1 kHz, dominated by the integrating capacitors.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on chosen capacitor values for the loop filter bandwidth.

f_max_phase.description: Frequency at which the phase reaches its maximum (closest to 0 degrees), providing the best phase margin for the PLL.

sky130_expected.calculation: Geometric mean of zero and pole frequencies. fz = 1/(2*pi*R1*C1) = 159 kHz, fp = (C1+C2)/(2*pi*C1*C2*(R1+R2)) = 1.46 MHz. f_max_phase = sqrt(fz*fp) = 482 kHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Designed to align with the PLL loop bandwidth for optimal stability.

step_response_voltage.description: Voltage at Vctrl after a 10us, 10uA current step, indicating the integration rate.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to charge pump current and inversely proportional to total capacitance.

sky130_expected.calculation: System level metric, depends on VCO.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Reported in paper for the full SSCG, not measurable on isolated loop filter.

spread_ratio.description: Center spread ratio of the SSCG.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Reported in paper for the full SSCG.
Reported in paper for the full SSCG.

timing_delay.description: Jitter or delay of the generated clock.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Reported in paper for the full SSCG.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the PLL loop filter, measuring AC transimpedance, phase margin frequency, and transient step response.
step3_testbench.spice:
* SSCG Loop Filter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param R1_val=10k R2_val=2k C1_val=100p C2_val=10p

* DUT
R2 Vctrl I2 {R2_val}
R1 I2 N1 {R1_val}
C1 N1 GND {C1_val}
C2 Vctrl GND {C2_val}

* Stimulus
Iin 0 I2 DC 0 AC 1 PULSE(0 10u 1n 1n 1n 10u 20u)

.control
* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 100 100Meg
let z_db = vdb(Vctrl)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(Vctrl))

meas ac z_1kHz find z_db at=1k
meas ac max_phase max phase
meas ac f_max_phase find frequency when phase=max_phase

* Transient Analysis
tran 10n 20u
meas tran v_at_10us find v(Vctrl) at=10u
quit
.endc
.end
